description: Creates a unit under a project or unit (`core.unit.create` at the parent; depth limit 6).

name.description: Display name of the new unit.

parentUnitId.description: Parent unit in the same project; null (default) creates it directly under the project.

settings.description: Regional overrides; absent fields inherit from the parent node.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for new amounts here; absent inherits the parent's.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of this node; absent inherits the parent's.

type.description: Registered unit type; it must allow the parent.
